critical_code_review_comments: Minor: setting localStorage 'wayly:app:appearance' = JSON.stringified('dark') on marketing routes (Landing/Contact) does NOT flip html.theme-dark on reload — the theme provider probably lives in the app shell only. It's not a regression from this batch (marketing pages were always outside .app-shell) and dark-mode styling was still verifiable by manually toggling html.classList.add('theme-dark') on /contact where the CSS rules for .contact-choice-active correctly switched to clay. If founder expects marketing to react to the same key, main agent may want to hoist the theme reader to <html> root; otherwise this is expected.

Non-blocking: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx is ~470 lines — still tidy, but adding a stable testID like dashboard-greeting-firstname would let automation assert the name split without regex; already good enough for now.
